assets.name: townhouse
assets.prompt: Production game sprite sheet. Use the attached existing cottage atlas ONLY as a style/material/camera reference. Create exactly four orthographic isometric views of the SAME upgraded house in a strict 2x2 regular grid. Top left front door faces southwest (screen down-left); top right faces southeast (screen down-right); bottom left faces northeast (back of house seen); bottom right faces northwest (back of house seen). Turn the same building 90 degrees each time, do not put the front door on the rear. Cozy Pine & Copper detailed SNES-style pixel art, warm timber, cream plaster, deep forest-green slate roofs, copper gutters, amber windows, flower boxes. Fixed 2:1 isometric camera, upright verticals, straight parallel roof edges, no perspective convergence or warping. Each building stands on an identical square stone foundation projected as a 2:1 diamond, entirely in its own cell, consistent scale and ground baseline across the four cells. Include front stairs and flowers INSIDE the foundation. Keep the foundation diamond axis-aligned to the camera. Whole roof and foundation visible, 5% clear transparent padding around all cell edges, no sprite touching another cell. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no background color, no checkerboard, no halo, no shadow outside foundations, no text, labels or UI. Tier 2: a handsome THREE-STOREY Alpine townhouse with an attic, clearly an upgrade of the cottage: more windows, sturdy stone ground floor, timber and cream plaster upper floors, one long flower balcony, symmetrical green gable roof with a small dormer, one copper-capped chimney. Compact square footprint; added capacity comes from another floor. Welcoming and practical, not a palace.
